title: Etale finite models imply intrinsic fixed-coefficient pro-etale models
statement: Under the hypotheses of finiteCoefficient_etaleLocal_encoding, the displayed etale-local property P(F) implies IsFinitelyPresentedLocallyConstantProEtaleModule for the inverse image of the fixed-scalar slice restriction of F under proEtaleModuleEncoding.

source.place: Tag 099Y, etale charts are pro-etale charts and pull back along pro-etale objects

proof.text: Evaluate the supplied etale-local condition at W=V and its identity arrow. Write the resulting covering sieve as the sieve of a family a_i:Z_i -> V. Its underlying scheme maps are jointly surjective and etale, hence form a pro-etale covering family of V.left by etalePrecoverage_le_proetalePrecoverage. This includes an empty covering of an empty chart.

For each cover member apply the proved sliceCoordinates functor to the supplied ringed-slice isomorphism. The proved sliceCoordinatesSquare identifies its image with finiteCoefficientSliceRestriction. The scalar adjunction unit is invertible because phi is an isomorphism; combine its inverse with koszulConstantScalarIso and constantLocalizationIso to identify the model image with the constant sheaf of the lifted module. fixedRestrictionComp identifies this chart restriction with inverse image of the restriction on V. Finite generation of the original module over the finite ring implies finiteness of its carrier, hence finite generation of the lifted module.

For every pro-etale test T over V.left, base change the covering family Z_i -> V.left to T. Each arrow Q in its generated sieve factors through one base change, hence admits a map p:Q.left -> Z_i.left with Q.hom=p followed by a_i.left. The proved fixedModelSchemeIso identifies slice models with scheme inverse-image models, and fixedConstantPullbackIso preserves the same constant module under p. Compose the supplied chart model with upperStarComp to give a finite fixed-coefficient model on Q.

The preceding covering argument proves fixedModels for finiteCoefficientSliceRestriction(V)(F). Transport along the inverse counit of proEtaleModuleEncoding and apply intrinsic_fixedModels backwards. The finite coefficient ring is Noetherian, so its finite modules are finitely presented. This gives the unchanged intrinsic local-model conclusion.

theorem finiteCoefficient_etaleLocal_encoding_forward_bridge
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (B : Type t) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X B).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{t + 1})
    (φ : adicConstantRing X B ⟶ R) (hφ : IsIso φ) (V : X.Etale)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{t + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)) :
    let R₀ := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R
    let P : ObjectProperty (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} R₀) := fun F ↦
      ∀ (W : X.Etale) (_g : W ⟶ V),
        ∃ S : Sieve W, S ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology W ∧
          ∀ (Z : X.Etale) (f : Z ⟶ W), S f →
            ∃ N : ModuleCat.{t} B, Module.Finite B N ∧ Nonempty
              ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj F ≅
                (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
                  ((completedAdicChange X (φ)).obj
                    ((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{t + 1, t} B ⋙
                      ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t + 1}
                        (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{t + 1} B ≃+* B).toRingHom ⋙
                      koszulConstantFunctor X B).obj N)))
    P F → IsFinitelyPresentedLocallyConstantProEtaleModule
      ((proEtaleModuleEncoding V.left B).inverse.obj
        ((finiteCoefficientSliceRestriction X B R φ V).obj F))
